A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] '''shaper''' was on the ''[[Baanu Rass]]'' in [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]]. He accompanied [[Nom Anor]] in the pursuit of the escaping [[voxyn queen]]. While trying to recapture the [[voxyn]] on an area of [[basal-comb]], the [[Shaper caste|shaper]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]].
